tasks.task: Smart search engine: own word index (works on MySQL and SQLite); finds words joined or spaced ('ukrainewar' = 'ukraine war'), single words from title, body, tags, categories, author; word forms (missile = missiles); typo fixing; ranking with title boost, phrase match and newer-first boost; snippets with the matched words
tasks.why: Built in step 4 (2026-11-05): own word index in three tables (search_terms vocabulary, search_post_terms inverted index with weights, search_docs fingerprints) filled on every story save, publish, trash and restore, plus a "Rebuild search index" button in Settings; searches title, body, excerpt, summary, tags, category and author; joined words split with the vocabulary ("ukrainewar"), longer forms match ("strike" finds "strikes"), typos are fixed with "Did you mean", results ranked (title and tag matches first, whole phrase higher, newer a little higher), snippets with the matched words highlighted; only public stories. Tested 2026-11-05 (step 4): the final full run on MySQL passed on all 18 projects (git/live x Chromium/Firefox/WebKit x phone/tablet/desktop): 1290 passed, 62 skipped, 0 failed (test-results/1793892035032-report.json). Fixed while testing: indexing one story runs as one transaction (two saves at once broke the primary key); words are cut to 64 letters (MySQL strict mode). Search keeps the 300 best matches (fine for hundreds of stories; raise it if the archive grows into the thousands). Approved by the owner 2026-11-11.

tasks.task: Page cache: cached pages expire at the next scheduled post; any admin save clears the cache
tasks.why: Built in step 4 (2026-11-05): public pages are rendered once and served from storage/cache/pages; a cached page expires at the next scheduled story's time (or a time to live set in Settings); every admin save (story, bulk status, homepage, author) clears the cache; admin pages, API answers, POSTs and pages with unknown query parameters are never cached. Tested 2026-11-05 (step 4): the final full run on MySQL passed on all 18 projects (git/live x Chromium/Firefox/WebKit x phone/tablet/desktop): 1290 passed, 62 skipped, 0 failed (test-results/1793892035032-report.json). The cache is now on in the test runs too, as on the real site; raw SQL in the tests clears it (tests/db.php). Fixed while testing: a page rendered from old data during a clear is never served (cache generation); the database is part of the cache key; new tags and categories clear the cache. 2026-11-10: the Host header is part of the cache key and must be a plain host name, so a made-up Host can never put another site's address into the pages people get (cache poisoning; tested). Approved by the owner 2026-11-11.
